description: This file defines layout constants, a custom panel class, and an enumeration for window presentation styles related to the Canvas feature in a macOS application.

classes.name: CanvasPanel
classes.description: A subclass of NSPanel that allows the panel to become key and main window.

methods.name: canBecomeKey
methods.description: Indicates that CanvasPanel can become the key window.

methods.name: canBecomeMain
methods.description: Indicates that CanvasPanel can become the main window.
